posts.headline: Forty-nine editions deep and Thicks still owes this league an explanation — Klint's Clipboard is 6-2 but 934.5 points-for remains the most anemic scoring total ever attached to a championship ring here.
posts.detail: A 1-15-1 career record paired with a title win doesn't erase the fact that this roster is winning ugly every single week, and the pedigree says the drop-off is coming.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are no longer a surprise, they're the gold standard, and triciagloston's 1128.92 points-for proves it week after week.
posts.detail: A rookie-ish 1-season résumé turned league-leading scoring machine at 6-2 — the quiet dominance storyline just keeps writing itself.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra is still stuck at 2-6 and the greatest résumé in Busters Anonymous history — 20-8 career, 1.5 average finish — is officially a cautionary tale.
posts.detail: Two titles' worth of pedigree sitting at 874.16 points-for is the most un-Barner stat line imaginable, and the crater just keeps getting deeper.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still winless at 0-8 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has become this league's full-blown plague of locusts.
posts.detail: 874.99 points-for with zero wins to show for it — the man who drafted a defensive player first overall is now living out his own personal Book of Job.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is still 2-6 with a league-worst 787.26 points-for, and Auntie Thomas's bottom-feeder pedigree is playing out exactly as scripted.
posts.detail: A career 6-8 record with a dead-last 10 average finish set the stage, and this season's scoreboard is just the sequel nobody asked for.
